response.justification: Bogdan has impressive experience in geospatial data processing through his work with GISCollective and Green Map, as well as proven capability in building low-latency distributed systems. However, his recent technical stack heavily favors TypeScript, Node.js, and Dlang. His C++ experience is brief and dated (2014-2015), and he lacks Rust experience, which makes him a risky fit for a role where modern C++ or Rust is the primary requirement. He could be considered if the team is willing to let him ramp up on C++/Rust.
strengths: Extensive domain knowledge in geospatial data platforms and GIS applications.
Proven ability to build low-latency, high-throughput distributed microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Strong focus on software craftsmanship, test-driven development (TDD), and rigorous quality assurance.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience with modern C++ or Rust, the primary languages for this role.
No direct experience mentioned in building navigation guidance solutions or routing tile data pipelines.
Recent roles have been heavily skewed toward full-stack web development rather than low-level backend data pipelines.
